schemes.name: Scheme-I (Product Certification / ISI Mark)
schemes.authority: BIS Act 2016 Section 13 / Conformity Assessment Regulations 2018
schemes.coverage: Domestic manufacturers and Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS)
processSteps: Standard Identification & Gap Analysis on Manakonline
Application Submission (Form I) with Factory Layout and Quality Manual
Factory Audit & Sample Drawing by BIS Quality Assurance Officers
Independent Sample Testing at BIS / NABL Recognized Labs
Periodic Surveillance Audits & Market Sample Testing
schemes.msmeBenefits: 50% concession on marking fees for Micro & Small Enterprises with Udyam registration.

schemes.name: Scheme-II (Compulsory Registration Scheme - CRS)
schemes.coverage: Information Technology, Electronic Products, Solar Inverters, LED Lighting
processSteps: Product Testing in BIS-Recognized Lab under LRS
Self-Declaration of Conformity based on Test Report
Labeling with Standard Mark (IS XXXXX / R-XXXXXXXX)

schemes.name: Scheme-III (Eco Mark Scheme)
schemes.authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest & Climate Change / BIS
schemes.coverage: Products meeting environmental criteria alongside Indian Standards quality benchmarks.

schemes.name: Scheme-IV (Hallmarking of Precious Metals)
schemes.compensationFormula: 3 * (Billed Purity % - Assayed Purity %) * Weight (grams) * Rate per gram
